content: Mede hebiniŋ halibuguk u Wapumdi Pol nimbihikuk
Biyagoŋ hinek, Pol nu yadi Judahi’walaŋ feknit mokit hidi Kilisto Jesu’walaŋ mede hanihautagut doktiŋa yot fafaŋeniŋ gineŋ napmegiŋ kaŋ hatilat.
Hidi nu’walaŋ mede kahat agaŋ nadigiŋ. Bepaŋ adi siloŋ tobogoŋŋiŋ doktiŋa hidi’walaŋkade Jesu’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ diniŋ kwanai titiŋdok naniŋguk.
U naniŋa mede hebiniŋ maaŋ nanimbihikuk. Mede u agaŋ muniniŋ-kabe youlat.
Hidi u yokunali, nu Kilisto’walaŋ mede hebiniŋ u walanedi nadidakalelat u kedem nadineeŋ.
Mede hebiniŋ uyadi metam koom hatitalabugiŋ adi mu yenimbihiliŋit. Uŋgoniŋ aposel eŋ polofet indi adigili Munabulidi mindaŋ ninimbihikuk.

Mede hebiniŋ u indiŋ. Metam Judahi’walaŋ feknit mokit hidi Jesu’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ wondoktiŋa Judame indut kiula bop kubugoŋ tiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ metam mintaaŋ hatiyam. Tiŋa Kilisto Jesu’walaŋkade gigitmededi folooŋnit tuguk u wanaŋ kahileeŋ kame hatidok yoŋit.
Ala nu Jesu’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ wondiniŋ tipilapilaye hatibaat yoŋa Bepaŋdi siloŋ tobogoŋŋiŋ doktiŋa saŋiniŋŋiŋ wapum halimilak wondiniŋ mebi nu foloŋ tubumintaguk.
Mede hebiniŋ diniŋ folooŋ Jesudi tubumintaguk
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, Kilisto’walaŋkade duhuduhu wapum kameka titiŋdok tuwot moŋ, u metam Judahi’walaŋ feknit mokit yenihautawaat yoŋa wondok kwanai fofooŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwanai-me fofoŋnit nu naniŋit.
Mede hebiniŋ yohautawaat yoŋa yoŋit uyadi indiŋ. Bepaŋ, nemenemek tubumintaguk, adi helemahelemaŋ nadinadiŋiŋ hebiniŋ u kabup weleŋ maaneŋ nadihabiyeune halimiŋtalabuguk.
Ala yoŋ adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kayoŋbopŋiye indi’walaŋkade nadinadi fuliŋgoŋ halimilak diniŋ folooŋ taŋakiyeune kudiŋiŋ mebimebi mintaune kunumnehi loloŋhinit eŋ saŋiniŋhinit hatiiŋ adi maaŋ kakiyondaiŋ.
Biyagoŋ hinek, Bepaŋ adi koomkwaha nainit mokitneŋ weleŋ maaneŋ nadihebet tuguk wondiniŋ folooŋ, Wapumnik Jesu Kilisto, niŋkulune foune mintadakaleguk.
Biyagoŋ hinek, Jesudigoŋ talik tubudidimenimbune adi nadisukilitimiŋa Bepaŋdi kedem nadinimbek yoŋa munta mu tiŋa niutumbaaŋ ninadiyam.

Unduŋ doktiŋa indiŋ hanimbe nadineŋ. Nu hiditok tiŋa mik-kwadi foloŋ hatibene hidi wondoktiŋa welehik mu gweheyewaak. Moŋ. Hidi adi tobo wendi hehitubu-lodaune Bepaŋgut momooŋ hatineem wondok nadifo tiyaneeŋ.
Poldi Efeso metamdok Bepaŋ ninadiguk
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, wondegoŋ tiŋa kunum gineŋ be kwetfoloŋ metambop hatiyam tuwot
inde’walaŋ Betnik folooŋ i mulelem timiŋa hiditok indiŋ yoŋa ninadi hatilat.
Bepaŋ loloŋnit hinekdi ne’walaŋ wougigit diniŋ duhuduhu wapum waaniŋ hatak haamdok yoguk u Munabuli nimbune adibo saŋiniŋ hambune welehik bedinaditom tibaak.
Unduŋ tiŋa Kilisto nadisukilitiune adi welehik kahileeŋ uŋgoŋ hatiluwaak. Unduŋ tubune hidi adi’walaŋ welesiloŋ gineŋ ulodi-kwambundaaŋ yakaneeŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa metam nadisukilitihinit nolidut wanakaŋ hogohogok bopneeŋ Jesu adi weleŋ hinekdi nibukahileguk wondiniŋ mebi, boki, koloŋ eŋ dabekŋiŋ u wanaŋ lodaaŋ nadidakaleneeŋ.
Tiŋa Kilisto’walaŋ welesiloŋ metam’walaŋ nadinadi kalakapmedapmalak u fiit nadihinakayaneeŋ. Unduŋ tubune Bepaŋ’walaŋ weleŋ gineŋ duhuduhu toki tiŋa itak wondi dahitokihamuluwaak.
Yonadifo mede
Biyagoŋ hinek, Bepaŋ adi saŋiniŋŋiŋ diniŋ mebi indi’walaŋkade tubumintaguk uyadi nemek tilak wondi yonadinik eŋ nadinadisunik u kalakapmedapmalak doktiŋa
kayoŋbopdi Jesu Kilisto wou foloŋ tonadifo wapum tubune Bepaŋ’walaŋkade tonadifodi youdihinit haliwooŋ halaak, fafaŋeniŋ. U biyagoŋ.
